justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/AztecReader.java, AztecWriter.java, and AztecDetectorResult.java: this package has only three classes, and its direct outgoing dependencies are mainly to internal subpackages (`com.google.zxing.aztec.decoder`, `detector`, `encoder`) plus the shared `com.google.zxing`/`common` APIs. The main external callers are core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/MultiFormatReader.java and MultiFormatWriter.java, which import AztecReader and AztecWriter, so the package has visible incoming use from the library entry points. I did not find evidence that this package is a highly stable package depending heavily on less-stable packages; it looks like a thin Aztec facade over internal implementation classes rather than an unstable dependency smell.
